subject: Aurelia Diagnostics — POC MAP Kickoff and Benchmark Owners
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@aureliadiagnostics.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aureliadiagnostics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Aurelia Diagnostics — POC MAP Kickoff and Benchmark Owners

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I want to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) for the 6-week POC so we’re aligned on success criteria, benchmarks, and who owns what. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a short eval benchmark list. Please review and reply with any edits.

Top-line proposal (summary):
- POC window: Sept 6 — Oct 15 (6 full weeks; week of Sept 6 is smoke/canary)
- Success criteria (any 2 of 3 to pass): 1) 95% intent accuracy on the clinical triage prompts; 2) median latency <= 220ms at 95th percentile; 3) cost per 1k tokens below $1.50 after batching/quantization recommendations.
- Benchmarks: we’ll run the supplied benchmark set (baseline run) and a prompt-variation sweep. Detailed list in eval_benchmark_list.md (attached).

Suggested stakeholder/owner matrix (please confirm or propose alternates):
- Redwood PM / POC owner: Laura Bennett (cc’d) — MAP steward, weekly status
- Redwood prompts & eval lead: Aditya Rao — prompt templates, evaluation harness, metric collection
- Redwood infra / deployment: Dev Patel — dedicated sandbox, region selection, privacy config
- Aurelia lead / product owner: Priya Desai — acceptance signoff, clinical review
- Aurelia engineering contact: Tom Hargreaves — integration, dataset handoff

Immediate asks (action items for kickoff):
1) Confirm owners above or add names for security/compliance (if separate).
2) Share the first tranche of sample logs and privacy checklist by Aug 27 so we can provision a dedicated test pool.
3) Choose a 60–90 minute MAP kickoff time next week; I’m proposing Tue Aug 25 10:00–11:30 PT.

I’ve attached Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx with milestones (milestone dates are draft). I’ll incorporate your edits and publish a living MAP doc in the shared Drive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0196

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx, eval_benchmark_list.md
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@aureliadiagnostics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aureliadiagnostics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurelia Diagnostics — POC MAP Kickoff and Benchmark Owners

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side:
- Timeline: we’re ok with Sept 6 start but would like the canary smoke tests to run the week of Aug 29 if Redwood can provision the sandbox earlier. Would that be possible?
- Security/compliance: add Michael Chen (external consultant) as our security lead — he’ll own the SOC/SIEM checklist and evidence requests. I’ve cc’d him on this reply.
- Success criteria: the clinical triage intent target looks good; we’d like one additional qualitative bar around hallucination rate: <2% on named-entity hallucinations for the triage flows. Can Redwood include hallucination tracking in the eval harness?

Also attaching an internal sample of the triage dataset we plan to use (will share full set when NDA/POC paper trail is in place).

On Tue Aug 25 at 10:00 PT works for our team for a kickoff meeting — please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Director, Product Engineering | Aurelia Diagnostics
tom.h@aureliadiagnostics.com

Action items before kickoff (Tue Aug 25 10:00 PT):
1) Tom / Priya: please confirm Michael Chen and copy his email if you want him on the invite.
2) Aurelia: share a small representative sample (100–200 anonymized items) for the baseline run by Aug 27.
3) Redwood: Aditya will drop initial prompt templates and eval harness instructions by EOD Aug 24.

I’ll send the calendar invite for Tue Aug 25 10:00–11:30 PT and upload the working MAP to the Drive.

—
Stephanie

- Dev: confirm sandbox sizing (2x A10G equiv initially) and whether we can front-load a small canary by Aug 29. If cloud quota is a blocker, flag and I’ll escalate.
- Stephanie: I’ll run the MAP baseline calendar and owner watchlist after the kickoff and prepare the weekly status template (short status + blockers).

A few items from our procurement / timeline side:
- We plan to issue the POC authorization and minimal SOW by Aug 30; formal PO will follow once we validate canary results.
- DocuSign: we have a draft ready; I’ll share the link during the kickoff.

Looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow.
